English: May the Force be with you.
To infinity and beyond!
Life is like a box of chocolates.
I'll be back.
Here's looking at you, kid.
There's no place like home.
Carpe diem. Seize the day, boys.
I'm the king of the world!
Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer.
Korean: 친구는 가까이 두고, 원수는 더 가까이 두어라.

English: Just keep swimming.
Why so serious?
Great power comes with great responsibility.
Show me the money!
You had me at hello.
Korean: 당신이 안녕이라고 말했을 때 이미 반했어요.

English: Houston, we have a problem.
Elementary, my dear Watson.
Hasta la vista, baby.
I'm going to make him an offer he can't refuse.
My precious.
Wakanda forever!
Chewie, we're home.
I am Iron Man.
I can do this all day.
Avengers, assemble!
I love you 3000.
Hakuna Matata!
Korean: 하쿠나 마타타! 다 잘 될 거야!

English: Remember who you are.
Let it go, let it go!
Some people are worth melting for.
Korean: 어떤 사람에겐 기꺼이 녹아내릴 수 있어.

English: Venture outside your comfort zone.
The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all.
Korean: 역경 속에서 피어난 꽃이 가장 희귀하고 아름답다.

English: Our fate lives within us. You only have to be brave enough to see it.
Korean: 운명은 우리 안에 있어. 볼 수 있을 만큼 용감해지면 돼.

English: Today is a good day to try.
You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
Korean: 너는 네가 믿는 것보다 용감하고, 보이는 것보다 강하며, 생각보다 똑똑해.

English: If you focus on what you left behind, you will never be able to see what lies ahead.
Korean: 지나간 일에만 연연하면 앞에 놓인 길을 볼 수 없어.

English: Your identity is your most valuable possession. Protect it.
Korean: 네 정체성은 가장 소중한 자산이야. 지켜내라.

English: Adventure is out there!
Laughter is timeless, imagination has no age, and dreams are forever.
Korean: 웃음은 영원하고, 상상력은 나이가 없으며, 꿈은 영원하다.

English: Always.
After all this time? Always.
Korean: 이 모든 시간이 지난 후에도? 영원히.

English: Wit beyond measure is man's greatest treasure.
Korean: 헤아릴 수 없는 지혜는 인간의 가장 큰 보물이다.

English: It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
Korean: 우리가 누구인지를 보여주는 것은 능력이 아니라 선택이다.

English: Words are, in my not-so-humble opinion, our most inexhaustible source of magic.
Korean: 말이란 나의 솔직한 의견으로 가장 무궁무진한 마법의 원천이다.

English: Do, or do not. There is no try.
Korean: 하든가, 하지 말든가 둘 중 하나다. 시도 따위는 없다.

English: Your eyes can deceive you. Don't trust them.
Korean: 눈은 너를 속일 수 있다. 믿지 마라.

English: Never tell me the odds.
Fear is the path to the dark side.
May the Force be with you, always.
